BEL margin miss and weak Q1 inflows are watch-points, not yet a P4 signal. [Source: PL Research 28-Jul-26; PSU Connect Aug-26; Bajaj Broking Q1 tracker 30-Jul-26]

AMC.note: S2 signals: DII deployment ~Rs76,030 Cr in Sep-26, Nippon record PAT and share gains. S3 signals: Nifty -6.1% in Sep-26 and -8.1% over 1 yr cuts equity AUM; Capital Markets index -7.2% in Sep. Indicators disagree, so the lower stage (Maturing) is used. [Source: Multibagg FII tracker 3-Oct-26; Finnovate sector returns Sep-26]

Exchanges / Depositories.note: BSE record quarter (PAT +66%, 5-Aug-26) but MCX profit -22% QoQ as volumes normalised after a record quarter; Capital Markets index -7.2% in Sep-26. Record volumes plus first QoQ decline = late cycle. [Source: Kotak Neo 5-Aug-26; IIFL 5-Aug-26; Finnovate Sep-26]

Brokers / Wealth.note: Volumes and fees at record levels in FY26-Q1 FY27 while Nifty fell 6.1% in Sep-26 and FPIs sold >Rs3 lakh Cr YTD. P3 vs P4 disagreement resolved to P4. [Source: Finnovate Sep-26; Multibagg 3-Oct-26]

Solar / Renewables.note: India on track for a record ~50 GW solar year in 2026 with ALMM-II (cells) driving H1 installs; cell supply tight. Module over-capacity (ICRA) is carried as a separate sector negative trigger. [Source: Wood Mackenzie / pv-magazine 14-Aug-26; TaiyangNews H1-26; ICRA via pv-magazine]

Pharma.note: Record margins at leaders (Sun gross margin 80.5%, Lupin EBITDA +50%) while key US exclusivities roll off (Lupin: 3 products ~50% EPS face competition from Q2 FY27) and the US imposes a 100% tariff on patented drugs (generics exempt for now). Record margins + fading exclusivities = late cycle. [Source: PL Research 10-Aug-26; India Briefing (Sec 232, Apr-26); Cofacto Sun call Jul-26]

Pharma (CDMO).note: CDMO deliveries driving Laurus (PAT +126%) and Neuland (PAT ~10x) in Q1 FY27; China+1/Biosecure sourcing shift continuing. [Source: Indian Pharma Post Jul-26; Multibagg Neuland Q1 Aug-26]

Power Financiers (PFC/REC/IREDA).note: PFC NII -4.45% YoY and standalone loans -0.7% QoQ; REC revenue -3%, profit -6% YoY; asset quality still clean (PFC GNPA 1.11%). RBI hiked repo to 5.50% in Oct-26, raising wholesale funding cost. Stalling growth with clean books = late cycle. [Source: Cofacto PFC Q1; Mercom REC Q1 Aug-26; RBI MPC Oct-26]

Capital Goods (Power/T&D).note: P3 signals: Hitachi orders +26% (ex-HVDC), record backlog Rs32,222 Cr; ABB orders +50%. P4 signals: capacity expansion announced across majors (GE Vernova Rs1,000 Cr, Hitachi 20th plant), GE gross margin -4 ppt, ABB margin pressure. Disagreement resolved to the lower phase. [Source: Hitachi Energy release Aug-26; ABB India Q2 CY26; Cofacto GVT&D call Aug-26]

EMS.note: S2 signals: Netweb revenue +172%, Syrma +67%. S3 signals: India smartphone shipments -3% YoY in Q1 2026 (six-year low), Dixon guiding only 12-15% FY27 growth on flat phones. Resolved to Maturing. [Source: Sahi 17-Jul-26; Autocar Pro Jul-26; Investywise Netweb Jul-26]

Chemicals (Specialty/Performance).note: Destocking over; SRF best-ever quarter (PAT +76%), Acutaas PAT +70% YoY, chemicals led Q1 profit growth. SRF itself flags normalisation ahead, so P2 is not used. [Source: Angel One SRF Q1 Jul-26; Bajaj Broking Q1 tracker]

Insurance.note: Health insurance expanding on GST exemption; Niva Bupa retail share >11%, PAT +93%. Insurance aggregate profit -15% in early Q1 data is life-insurer led. [Source: Angel One Niva Bupa Q1; Bajaj Broking Q1 tracker]

Railways.note: Nifty India Railways PSU -24.5% over 1 yr (Sep-26) = bad news priced; RVNL Q1 order inflow up ~4x and EBITDA margin +275 bps. Order turn (P2 sign) vs depressed prices (P1) -> P1. [Source: Finnovate Sep-26; Cofacto RVNL Q1]

Hospitals.note: Bed additions everywhere; Max Q1 PAT only +4.9% on new-bed dilution; healthcare-services sales +2.6% in early Q1 aggregate. [Source: Kotak Neo Max Q1 Aug-26; Bajaj Broking Q1 tracker]

Banking (PSU).note: Q1 bank profit +27.8% with GNPA near cycle lows (BoM 1.45%), but RBI moved to 'calibrated tightening' (repo 5.50%, Oct-26) and FPIs are heavy sellers. Peak-profit, low-credit-cost = late cycle. [Source: Bajaj Broking Q1 tracker; RBI MPC Oct-26]

NBFC (Gold Loan).note: Muthoot AUM +43% YoY but driven by gold price (pledged tonnage fell 209->197 t); NIM fell 13.38%->10.41% QoQ on competition. [Source: INDmoney 3-Aug-26]

Hotels.note: IHCL Q1 revenue +15% (record); ARR cycle intact. Brent >$100 and war risk are carried as a sector negative trigger. [Source: Kotak Neo IHCL Q1 Jul-26; HDFC Sky 19-Sep-26]
